description: Source code for the TeleReporterEmitter class, which implements the ReporterV2 interface for reporting test events in Playwright, including serialization of test suite, test case, step, and attachment data, and communication via message sink.

classes.name: TeleReporterEmitter
classes.description: Implements test reporting by serializing test events and sending them through a message sink.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string 'v2'.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Serializes and reports the test configuration.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Serializes and reports the beginning of a test suite.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Marks the start of a test and reports it.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a test, reports results, and attachments.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Marks the start of a test step and reports it.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a test step and reports it.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Reports a test error.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Reports standard output during tests.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Reports standard error during tests.

methods.name: _onStdIO
methods.description: Handles reporting of stdio chunks, encoding to base64 if needed.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Reports the end of the full test run.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates whether the reporter prints to stdio (returns false).

methods.name: _serializeConfig
methods.description: Serializes the full test configuration.

methods.name: _serializeProject
methods.description: Serializes a test project and its suite.

methods.name: _serializeProjectUseOptions
methods.description: Serializes project-specific use options.

methods.name: _serializeSuite
methods.description: Serializes a test suite and its entries.

methods.name: _serializeTest
methods.description: Serializes a test case.

methods.name: _serializeResultStart
methods.description: Serializes the start state of a test result.

methods.name: _serializeResultEnd
methods.description: Serializes the end state of a test result.

methods.name: _sendNewAttachments
methods.description: Sends new attachments for a test result.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Serializes test attachments, encoding bodies to base64 if not omitted.

methods.name: _serializeStepStart
methods.description: Serializes the start of a test step.

methods.name: _serializeStepEnd
methods.description: Serializes the end of a test step.

methods.name: _relativeAnnotationLocations
methods.description: Converts annotation locations to relative paths.

methods.name: _relativeLocation
methods.description: Converts a location to a relative path based on rootDir.

methods.name: _relativePath
methods.description: Converts an absolute path to a relative path based on rootDir.
